# link next

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:linkNext`](gmeow-linkNext.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/linkNext>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/risk`](../../slices/risk.md)

The next link in a cascade walk. NOT functional (a link may feed branches; a branching failure tree is one cascade entry with diverging walks) and NOT transitive — reachability is solver work. Acyclic (SHACL): no link reaches itself through [`linkNext`](gmeow-linkNext.md).

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:CausalLink`](../classes/gmeow-CausalLink.md) -> [`gmeow:CausalLink`](../classes/gmeow-CausalLink.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:linkNext`](gmeow-linkNext.md) from [`gmeow:CausalLink`](../classes/gmeow-CausalLink.md) to [`gmeow:CausalLink`](../classes/gmeow-CausalLink.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.
